blocks.text: Demography populations ki khasiyaton ka shumariyati (statistical, yaani ginti aur adaad wala) mutala hai. Population ka size demography ki sab se ahem khasiyat hai, kyun ke yeh seedha is baat se juda hai ke koi population zinda reh sakegi ya nahin.

blocks.prompt: Demography kya hai, aur is mein sab se ahem khasiyat kaun si hai?
blocks.explanation: Populations ki khasiyaton ka statistical mutala; sab se ahem khasiyat population ka size hai, kyun ke yeh population ke zinda rehne ki salahiyat se juda hai.

items: Demography: populations ki statistics; population size sab se ahem, kyun ke is se population ke bachne ka pata chalta hai.
